PARAMS = {
    "gmid_b": (18, 12, 24),   # gm/Id of bottom pair M1/M2 and gate-bias diode MG (sets bottom Vdsat)
    "gmid_t": (16, 10, 22),   # gm/Id of top pair M3/M4 (sets Vgs3, and the top Vds mismatch)
    "L_b":    (3.0, 0.5, 10), # bottom channel length (um)
    "L_t":    (3.0, 0.5, 10), # top channel length (um), sets VA_top and hence the output error
}

VDD = 1.8

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = spec["iin"]                      # 20 uA reference / target current
    vout = spec["vout_nom"]              # 0.9 V

    # Sizes: mirrored pairs share L and gm/Id, and are scaled by Id (=I) only.
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], I)   # M1, M2, MG (bottom)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], I)   # M3, M4 (top cascodes)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")

    # Reference branch: iin -> M3 (diode, gate=drain=iin) -> xr -> M1 -> vss
    n.dev("M3", "iin", "iin", "xr", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "xr", "g1", "vss", "vss", mb)

    # Output branch: iout -> M4 (gate on iin node) -> yo -> M2 -> vss
    n.dev("M4", "iout", "iin", "yo", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M2", "yo", "g1", "vss", "vss", mb)

    # Bottom gate bias: diode MG (same size as M1) fed from VDD through RG carrying I.
    # Places g1 at Vgs(I), so M1/M2 sit at the edge of saturation with Vds ~ Vdsat.
    n.dev("MG", "g1", "g1", "vss", "vss", mb)
    rg = (VDD - mb.vgs) / I
    n.R("RG", "vdd", "g1", rg)

    # ---- First-order predictions ----
    x_est = mb.vdsat                     # bottom Vds (y ~ x for matched bottom pair)
    vds_ref_top = mt.vgs                 # M3 is diode-connected: Vds3 = Vgs3
    vds_out_top = vout - x_est           # M4 Vds at nominal output
    # Top-device Vds mismatch sets the current error: dI/I = gds * dV / I
    err_pct = 100.0 * mt.gds * abs(vds_out_top - vds_ref_top) / I
    compliance = mb.vdsat + mt.vdsat     # wide-swing: ~2 Vdsat, no Vth stacking
    rout = mt.intrinsic_gain * mb.intrinsic_gain / mb.gm   # Rout ~ gm4*ro4*ro2
    power = VDD * I                      # RG bias current; ideal source current not counted

    return n, {
        "iout_err_pct": err_pct,
        "v_compliance": compliance,
        "rout": rout,
        "power": power,
    }
